claim: ROG has the densest combined premium-platform proof cluster.
evidence: Five M.2 slots, three Gen5 M.2 slots, dual LAN, and the deepest named tuning / AI feature set in the bounded comparison.
decision_relevance: Lead with the combined workflow advantage instead of isolated spec wins.

claim: MSI created a $210 observed price gap versus ROG.
evidence: $389.99 official-store promotion versus the $599.99 ROG direct price captured September 22, 2026.
decision_relevance: Treat MSI as the primary value anchor while keeping the promotional caveat visible.

claim: ROG leads three performance-led buyer personas.
evidence: 89.7 Competitive Gamer, 94.9 Enthusiast / OC, and 94.8 Creator / AI weighted-fit scores.
decision_relevance: Prioritize enthusiast and creator channels where the premium has the strongest modeled defense.

claim: AORUS narrowly leads the Premium DIY persona.
evidence: 86.9 for AORUS versus 86.5 for ROG—a 0.4-point modeled margin.
decision_relevance: Avoid a universal-winner claim and strengthen proof around installation experience.

claim: A targeted ROG promotion improves fit without changing the product story.
evidence: The $449.99 scenario raises average persona fit from 91.5 to 93.7 while holding every non-price input constant.
decision_relevance: Use controlled bundles or promotional windows instead of a permanent list-price reset.

claim: The MSI price gap is durable enough to require a structural response.
evidence: One dated promotional observation cannot establish sustained channel pricing.
decision_relevance: Track manufacturer and retailer prices for 30 days before changing the long-term price architecture.

claim: Buyers value and describe the proof clusters the same way the model does.
evidence: Persona weights are explicit product hypotheses, not interview-validated preference data.
decision_relevance: Use structured interviews and review coding to revise weights and message language.

claim: Counted DIY and software features translate into better real-world execution.
evidence: Feature presence does not establish firmware maturity, memory stability, thermals, or usability quality.
decision_relevance: Add hands-on or trusted independent evidence before making product-quality claims.
